prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1423; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck pain, low back pain, and stiffness radiating into the upper shoulders. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness at the cervical and lumbar regions with restricted range of motion in flexion and rotation. Neurological screening was within normal limits, and there were no signs of radiculopathy. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the clinical picture.

Over the course of 30 visits, treatment consisted of a combination of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise focused on core stabilization and cervical range of motion, and home exercise instruction. Pain levels and functional tolerance improved steadily, with the patient reporting a reduction in neck and back symptoms and a return to most daily activities. Residual intermittent stiffness persists with prolonged sitting and driving, particularly in the morning.

Prognosis is considered good. Continued independent home exercise program, ergonomic adjustments during work, and periodic reassessment are recommended. Discharge from active care is appropriate at this time, with return precautions provided should symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
